legal.lead: Transparency about your data and how you may use TellYouTo.
legal.privacyBody:
TellYouTo favours your personal space: most of your intentions stay on the device in a local SQLite database, protected like the rest of your system storage.

If you enable cloud sync with Firebase, only data needed for the service is exchanged; access relies on Firebase authentication and server-side security rules. We do not sell your content to third parties.

You can wipe local data by rebuilding the database from pilot tools (advanced). For legal questions (GDPR, etc.), seek advice suited to your case.
legal.termsBody:
By using TellYouTo you accept an experience focused on focus and wellbeing. The app is provided “as is”; AI and suggestions may be imperfect — you remain responsible for your decisions.

Connectors and simulations must be used lawfully and respectfully toward third-party services.

We may update this text or features for clarity or compliance; the version shown in the app prevails.

morning.structure: Before you dive in: a short list is enough to frame your rail.
morning.momentum: High energy on scan—ready to move your rail when you are.
morning.zen: Morning. One calm intention to steady your head—then the rest.
morning.stats: Open the day with one clear number or milestone; the rest can follow.

afternoon.structure: Midday reset: a tiny reframe keeps the afternoon honest.
afternoon.momentum: Afternoons love rhythm—keep one sharp intention within reach.
afternoon.zen: Breathe: pick a quiet pocket for your next block.

evening.momentum: You pushed hard today—rest the engine; the rail will be here tomorrow.

night.zen: Quiet night: one light intention—or simply rest.
night.stats: Dashboards sleep till morning—maybe you should too.
